description: This file defines a web page code-behind class 'TakenCourses' for an online examination system. It contains event handlers for navigation buttons that transfer the user to different pages such as Dashboard, UserProfile, Leaderboard, and LoginPage.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: A web page class derived from System.Web.UI.Page facilitating navigation through button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does not contain any logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the UserProfile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Leaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the LoginPage when the logout button is clicked.
